dreamteamer.title: Engagements
dreamteamer.description: `engagements`: one record per working relationship with a company — `stage` lead, client or closed, with its champion and key contacts, where it stands, what is owed, and the arc so far. `/update-engagements` folds new meeting summaries into it. The pipeline board groups by stage; each company lists its engagements.
